name: Meeting Prep n8n Workflow 🗓️  ➡️ 🎧
description_md:
## What You Get

- A plug-and-play n8n workflow that transforms Calendly bookings into personalized audio briefings.

- Automatic research on the attendee and their company using Perplexity and OpenAI.

- AI-generated meeting summary sent straight to your inbox as a short, digestible voice note.

- Seamless Gmail integration to deliver prep materials ahead of every call.

- JSON file included for instant import—no manual config needed.

If you're looking for this resource and TONs of exclusive videos, resources, goodies, AND coaching, consider joining my Early AI-dopters Community. You won't regret it 😉
